visualCharacteristics.purpose: Top-of-page banner with the page title on a solid panel beside a photo
visualCharacteristics.panel: solid beige text panel left, image right half
visualCharacteristics.heading: large red serif H1
visualCharacteristics.notes: Text on a solid panel on the left, photo on the right half (not a full-bleed background image). Stacks text over image below 900px.

contentPattern.structure: row 1: image; row 2: H1 heading (optional paragraphs). Cell order is not significant: the first picture becomes the media column, everything else the text panel

usage: Use once at the top of a page for the page title with a supporting photo shown beside (not behind) the text.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any page banner with a heading on a solid panel and a side image. Use the plain hero block when the image is a full-bleed background behind the text.
